title: Optimized FE Plan
intro: The smallest set of changes inside packages/trader_watchlist that removes per-frame and per-update waste without new dependencies, shared-package edits or feature flags. Every item keeps today's screens, data, routes and analytics; it only stops work that does not change what is drawn.
meta_note: 11 small pull requests, all in trader_watchlist

items.title: Header pin state emitted only on change
items.risk_why: The header never pins, so identical emits cannot change the output.
test: Scroll Bench 20 down and up; header scrolls away and back.
items.effect: No full header rebuild on each frame of a downward scroll; the main code-side gain for S5.

items.title: Stable list and row keys
items.risk_why: Rows are updated in place instead of recreated; swipe state still resets per scrip through Slidable's own key.
test: Prices tick after open, sort, refresh, add/remove.
items.effect: Rows are no longer torn down on every list update; less garbage per open (R9).

items.title: Rows release their listener and controllers
test: Tooltips hide on scroll and swipe.
items.effect: Disposed rows are not kept alive by the app-scoped cubit's stream.

items.title: One tooltip StreamController per listing
items.risk_why: Same stream; created once and closed.
test: Manage Watchlists sheet with an empty list still builds.

items.title: One tick stream per row
items.risk_why: Same filter and first value; only identity kept.
test: Prices tick after sort, refresh and list switch.
items.effect: No resubscribe and extra build per row on each list update.

items.title: Resubscribe only when visible rows change
items.risk_why: Any change of the visible set still subscribes.
test: Newly visible rows tick after scrolling.
Holdings list keeps its P&L symbols.
items.effect: Fewer rect walks, subscribe packets and broadcaster log lines.

items.title: No shrinkWrap on the bounded list
items.risk_why: Layout change; parent is bounded so the result should be identical.
test: Lists of 1, 20, 100 stocks; pull to refresh; heatmap view.
items.effect: Less layout work when row heights change.

items.title: Shell rebuilds only on tab changes
items.risk_why: Changes which state rebuilds the screen shell; the list keeps its own builder.
test: Open, switch chips, sort, refresh; switch Option List / Comm. List and back; coach marks.
items.effect: One header rebuild fewer per list update (2+ per open).

items.title: Cubit forgets the disposed screen
items.risk_why: Existing guards already treat a missing context as 'do not show'.
test: Leave the tab during a slow fetch; no crash.
items.effect: The last screen's element can be collected.

items.title: Start the watchlist call without waiting for MTF
items.risk_why: Loading order changes; MTF tags still applied before the network emit.
test: MTF tags present after open; MTF failure does not block the list.
items.effect: Watchlist request starts one MTF round-trip earlier (to be measured).

items.title: Label the list menu for screen readers

achieve.after: ≈ 25–35 MB (estimate; rest needs B5, B6 and B7)
slightly lower (≈ 40–45 %); most of it needs A2 and A4
slightly lower; most of it needs A2, A4, A5
shorter by one MTF round-trip (to be measured)

notice: Scrolling the watchlist feels smoother on 120 Hz phones.
Nothing else looks different: same rows, prices, gestures and menus.
TalkBack can name the list menu.
one_line: Smoother scrolling and less memory growth on the watchlist, with no visible change and no shared-package edits.
schedule_intro: Two FE developers; each item is one pull request with its test.

rows.work: Header pin guard with test; one tick stream per row.
Remove shrinkWrap; resubscribe only on visible-set change (after item 2).
Shell rebuild only on tab changes; MTF in parallel; profile build on the OPPO.
Row cleanup and one tooltip controller, with the leak test.
Stable keys with the remount test.
Cubit context release; kebab accessibility label; regression pass.

not_fixed.what: Most of the idle CPU and identical idle frames
not_fixed.why: Needs the row tick filter (behind a flag), the wealth tile change in the shared mo_app_bar package and a Product decision on the rotation.
The texture render mode is set in the app shell and needs a flagged A/B.
Leaks in shared packages and possible Java/SDK growth need shared edits and a heap dump.
Visible change that needs Product, a flag, and the shared connectivity-listener fix.
Feed cadence is a BE question; keeping the socket open is a shared-package and Product trade-off.

not_fixed.where: client code and noisy API logs remain
not_fixed.why: All in shared packages (trader_core, trader_network, trader_widgets) and the app manifest.
